repo.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repo.description_zh: 一個專為配合 Stitch MCP server 設計的 Agent Skills 函式庫。每個 skill 都遵循 Agent Skills 開放標準，以便與 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code、Cursor 等 coding agents 相容。

card.hook: 讓 AI Coding Agent 變超強！

points.text: 遵循 Agent Skills 標準，輕鬆串接不同工具。
